queue.what: make DSV4_BLKSWEEP's adaptK field mean what it says

queue.detail: adaptK = adaptSweep[bsi] > 0.f ? adaptSweep[bsi] : (getenv("NO_ADAPTK") ? 0.f : 1.5f) — an entry of 0 is indistinguishable from unset and falls through to the 1.5 default. The fix is a sentinel for 'unset' (e.g. -1) so 0 can mean 0; it must be re-gated with DSV4_PARSE_ONLY=1 and one within-run point. Cycle 3 avoided the trap by never requesting 0, so cycle 3 also contains NO fixed-width control.
